context: Request: the latest Bankruptcy & Restructuring matter where a plan of reorganization the firm produced was actually confirmed. Rubric: 1006-00002 (Crestline Packaging), plus a precision criterion.

stages.note: Whole-store glob. Review: partly (listing capped).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts and lists all matter folder names. Review: yes.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with broad terms; times out after about 1.2M chars. Review: no.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path search for request words in parallel with full listings of six candidate matters (labelled by the search). Review: partly.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Narrower path search and a folder-name search; one matter has dedicated court-stage folders (attempt 2). Review: partly.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists six other candidate matters and reruns a narrow path search in parallel. Review: partly.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response

stages.note: Checks paths with visible output (attempt 2). Review: partly.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: T0 and T2 found the matter through file-name searches (it has dedicated court-stage folders), read its order, filed document and engagement letter in depth and passed; their store-wide extraction scans timed out with 0.7-1.2M chars of output without filling the context. T1 made the same file-name finds but then ran a store-wide scan that printed snippets for broad terms with no cap (about 72M chars); the context filled and the run ended without a response (context overflow, no review). The runs split at the extraction scan: T1 scanned after its file-name searches instead of opening the matter they had shown.
